color_system.summary: Accent header field with reverse type on content slides; white panels on a tinted page; full-bleed accent with reverse type on cover, section divider (left half) and closing checklist. Accent is per subject, one muted-academic family.

style_axis.summary: style is an optional request param. Absent, unknown, or not applicable to the band/subject -> falls back to 'clean' per slide. Non-default styles insert their id into the filename before the version; clean templates keep their three-segment names.

notebook.export: rasterize for g1_2/g3_5; editable for g6_8
notebook.grammar: Story / vocabulary / passage pages for language arts

grid_studio.export: rasterize for g1_2/g3_5; editable for g6_8
grid_studio.grammar: Warm-up → Concept → Worked Example → Your Turn → Challenge

field_lab.export: rasterize for g1_2/g3_5; editable for g6_8
field_lab.grammar: Big Question → Prediction → Investigation → Observation → Discovery

archive_desk.export: rasterize for g3_5; editable for g6_8
archive_desk.grammar: Locate → Timeline → Evidence → Cause–Effect → Compare → So What

band_boundaries.outcome: KEEP g1_2 / g3_5 / g6_8 as defined in styles/grade-bands.json.
band_boundaries.reason: Target schools genuinely group grades 3–5 as one stage, so the repo's existing bands match how teachers already think. The earlier 1–3 / 4–5 tier sketch is superseded and should not be reintroduced.
band_boundaries.consequence: Grade 3 receives the g3_5 variant: joined handwriting (Caveat) where the style uses one, ~55 words per page, and type measured around grade 4. This is accepted, not overlooked.
band_boundaries.revisit_if: Teachers report grade 3 pupils struggling to read the joined face. The cheap mitigation is a font-only change — swap Caveat for Andika in the g3_5 variant of notebook and field_lab — which needs re-measuring but no re-banding and no new template ids.
